verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs say it records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles, using either a visible bot or botless desktop audio capture. Users can choose when to record, pause, or resume, and admins can set organization-wide recording policies, which covers the "recording where I want it" part of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of capture reliability on each platform, and detailed per-platform setup or limitation documentation.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles

Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one — capturing audio directly from the desktop across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and in-person meetings
Users choose when to record, pause, or resume capture when part of a conversation needs to stay off the record.
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained
